The subagent found 16 `http.matchers.*` modules registered outside test files. Its summary first said 18, then corrected the count to 16. The 16 below are the ones it listed.

| Module ID | File |
|---|---|
| `http.matchers.vars` | `modules/caddyhttp/vars.go` |
| `http.matchers.vars_regexp` | `modules/caddyhttp/vars.go` |
| `http.matchers.host` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.path` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.path_regexp` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.method` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.query` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |

| `http.matchers.tls` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.not` | `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.remote_ip` | `modules/caddyhttp/ip_matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.client_ip` | `modules/caddyhttp/ip_matchers.go` |
| `http.matchers.expression` | `modules/caddyhttp/celmatcher.go` |
| `http.matchers.file` | `modules/caddyhttp/fileserver/matcher.go` |

- **How it was checked:** The subagent grepped for the ID string literals. It did not open each `CaddyModule()` method. It assumed `vars_regexp` belongs to `MatchVarsRE` based on the registration order in `vars.go`.
- **No dynamic IDs:** None of the IDs are built at runtime. The dynamic `"http.matchers." + name` strings in `modules/caddyhttp/matchers.go` and `caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/httptype.go` are lookups, not registrations.
- **Placeholders, not modules:** Strings like `http.matchers.file.relative` are placeholder names, not module IDs.
